lines.text: Many learners say: I am twenty years.
Better: I am twenty years old.
Old! My sister is five years old.

native.tip: 中文说“我二十岁”，“岁”就够了。英语的 years 后面要加 old，才是完整的年龄。
native.caption: 你是不是也会说 “I am twenty years.”😅 中文“二十岁”够了，英语要加 old：“I am twenty years old.”跟着 Carlos 老师读一读！在 Lexkite 应用里练习更多。
native.comment: 答案：“I am twenty years old.”大声读一遍，再写一句你自己的句子。免费测验在这里：{link}

en.tip: In Chinese “twenty years” is enough, but English needs old after years.
en.caption: Do you say “I am twenty years.” 😅 English needs old after years: “I am twenty years old.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
